title: The One Percent Solution
goal: Introduce the protagonist to the System and reveal the broken 'Crit' multiplier during a fatal tutorial encounter.
stakes_shift: From certain death as a mundane human to survival as a glitched outlier with a lethal damage ceiling.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in the real world and awakens in the tutorial zone.
bridge.to_next: Armed with a broken mechanic, the protagonist seeks to maximize tutorial rewards before the zone closes.

sections.title: The Fatal Error
sections.intent: Establish the protagonist's mundane death and the jarring transition into the System tutorial.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.

scenes.summary: Artie dies in a hospital bed and experiences a surreal transition into a digital void.
scenes.outcome: Artie is transported to the tutorial zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie’s consciousness slips away as the hospital room monitor emits a long, flat tone.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie’s eyes snap open to find himself standing in a featureless white expanse.

scenes.summary: Artie explores the white void and interacts with the first System prompt.
scenes.outcome: Artie accepts the tutorial and gains his first status window.
scenes.transition_in_text: The humming of the white expanse intensifies as a blue window flickers into existence.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie reaches out to touch the floating prompt, and the world shifts around him.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.

sections.title: Identifying the Glitch
sections.intent: Introduce the combat mechanics and the first realization that the Crit multiplier is behaving abnormally.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.

scenes.summary: Transition handoff from White Void Center to White Void Center.
scenes.outcome: The handoff is concretely realized and constraints are carried forward.
scenes.transition_in_text: After a arrival checkpoint, the movement from White Void Center to White Void Center is realized on page.
scenes.transition_out_text: This beat pushes into a arrival checkpoint toward the Training Arena.

scenes.summary: Artie approaches a training dummy and attempts basic combat maneuvers.
scenes.outcome: Artie learns the basics of the combat system.
scenes.transition_in_text: The white void resolves into a structured training arena containing a single straw dummy.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie grips the wooden sword, feeling the strange weight of a digital weapon.

scenes.summary: Artie strikes the dummy multiple times, noticing a strange variance in damage numbers.
scenes.outcome: Artie identifies a pattern in his critical hits.
scenes.transition_in_text: The first strike lands with a dull thud, but the damage readout flickers erratically.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie narrows his eyes as a '1.5x' multiplier suddenly jumps to '10x' for no reason.

scenes.summary: Artie focuses on the timing of his strikes and triggers a massive physics-breaking crit.
scenes.outcome: The training dummy is destroyed by a 100x crit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie swings with everything he has, aiming for the exact moment the multiplier glitches.
scenes.transition_out_text: The dummy vanishes in a spray of corrupted pixels as the System struggles to calculate the damage.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.

sections.title: The First Payday
sections.intent: Show the protagonist intentionally using the glitch to secure high-value loot from the first tutorial mob.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses.

scenes.summary: Transition handoff from Training Arena to Training Arena.
scenes.outcome: The handoff is concretely realized and constraints are carried forward.
scenes.transition_in_text: After a arrival checkpoint, the movement from Training Arena to Training Arena is realized on page.
scenes.transition_out_text: This beat pushes into a arrival checkpoint toward the Tutorial Dungeon Entrance.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the first live-combat zone and encounters a tutorial rat.
scenes.outcome: Artie prepares to test the glitch on a live enemy.
scenes.transition_in_text: A stone corridor manifests around Artie, smelling of damp earth and digital decay.
scenes.transition_out_text: A pair of red eyes glows in the darkness of the corridor ahead.

scenes.summary: Artie engages the tutorial rat, carefully managing his strikes to build the multiplier.
scenes.outcome: Artie successfully stacks the glitch against the rat.
scenes.transition_in_text: The tutorial rat lunges, but Artie sidesteps, waiting for the multiplier to pulse.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie brings the wooden sword down in a perfect arc as the multiplier hits its peak.

scenes.summary: Transition handoff from Tutorial Dungeon Entrance to Tutorial Dungeon Entrance.
scenes.outcome: The handoff is concretely realized and constraints are carried forward.
scenes.transition_in_text: After a offscreen processing, the movement from Tutorial Dungeon Entrance to Tutorial Dungeon Entrance is realized on page.
scenes.transition_out_text: This beat carries directly into the final moments at the Tutorial Dungeon Entrance.

scenes.summary: The rat is obliterated by an overkill strike, and Artie loots a legendary item.
scenes.transition_in_text: The rat explodes with the force of a small bomb, leaving behind a shimmering golden chest.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses.
